channel.title: Resorts on YumFam
channel.description: Recent content in Resorts on YumFam

item.title: Beijing Shiyuan Hyatt — 1 Night + Breakfast + Pick-3 Activity Pass from ¥699
item.description: Hyatt Regency Beijing Shiyuan in Yanqing's Expo Park area: 1 night in a Hyatt room with breakfast for 2 adults + 1 child, plus your pick of 3 from 6 attractions — hot-spring soak, iQiyi Qibabu kids park, Expo botanical garden, XR experience and more — at about 37% of the ¥1,938 rack value.

item.title: Sanya Swissôtel Yalong Bay — 2 Nights + Breakfast & Dinner from ¥1,299
item.description: Accor's Swissôtel in Sanya's Yalong Bay: Swiss-style family rooms, daily breakfast for 2 adults + 2 kids, one buffet dinner for two, an 800㎡ kids club, lagoon-style pool, and a ~5-minute walk to the beach — 2 nights from ¥1,299, about 44% of the ¥2,999 rack value.

item.title: Beijing Junhe Howard Johnson — 1 Night + Unlimited 3,000㎡ Hot Spring Spa from ¥598
item.description: Hot-spring season at Beijing Junhe Howard Johnson on the Chaobai River: 1 night in a 45㎡ room with buffet breakfast for two, unlimited access to 3,000㎡ of indoor/outdoor hot-spring pools, plus tickets to the Sacred Deer Forest theme park and an alpaca-feeding pack — zero weekend surcharges.

item.title: Sanya Tianliwan Grand Hyatt — 2 Nights + Daily Breakfast for 2 Adults + 2 Kids from ¥1,188
item.description: Grand Hyatt's 2023 flagship in Sanya: 3 days 2 nights with daily buffet breakfast for 2 adults + 2 kids (under 12), a 30-minute travel photoshoot, a private pink-sand beach, 2,800㎡ of pools, and a shuttle to the duty-free mall — from ¥1,188 (≈$164).

item.title: Atlantis Sanya — 2 Nights Sea-View Room + Waterpark & Aquarium for 2 Adults + 2 Kids, from ¥2,788
item.description: Off-peak steal at Sanya's Atlantis: 2 nights in a sea-view room plus unlimited Aquaventure Waterpark and Lost Chambers Aquarium access for 2 adults and 2 kids (11 and under), with three underwater shows and a free dolphin meet-and-greet.

item.title: Fragrant Hill Hotel Beijing — Autumn Stay Inside the Park, from ¥569
item.description: A garden twin room inside Fragrant Hill Park with breakfast for 2 adults + 1 child and free park entry throughout your stay.

item.title: Shanghai Haichang Ocean Park Resort — 1 Night + 2-Day Unlimited Park Entry
item.description: Cruise-themed ocean park resort: 1 night in a superior room, breakfast for 2, unlimited 2-day park entry for 2 adults and a dedicated VIP entry lane.

item.title: Wanda Realm Haitang Bay Sanya — 2 Nights from ¥999
item.description: Two nights in a garden-view room with daily breakfast for 2, a free first-day minibar, daily kids' activities and an open-air garden cinema.

item.title: Beihaiwan Hotel Xiamen — 2 Nights + Water Parks, Zero Surcharge
item.description: Two nights in a terrace room with hot-spring water park + bounce park and daily breakfast.

item.title: Fliport Portman Xiamen — Seaview Room + Magic Academy
item.description: Seaview room with afternoon tea, XR magic academy and kids' club activities.

item.title: Le Meridien Xiamen — Balcony Room + Family Perks
item.description: Garden-view balcony room with breakfast for 2 adults + 2 kids and meal vouchers.

item.title: Qishang Hotel Xiamen — Waterside Family Suite, 2 Nights
item.description: Two nights in a waterside kids-themed suite with private terrace, afternoon tea and spa pool.

item.title: Riyuegu Hot Spring Resort — Day Pass
item.description: Natural hot spring day pass with dining voucher and kids' activities — usable through the holiday.

item.title: Shengzhixiang Xiamen — Hot Spring Family Stay, 2 Nights
item.description: Two flexible nights with hot springs — swap for breakfast or mix and match.

item.title: Yuehua Hotel — Courtyard Family Room
item.description: Courtyard-themed family room with breakfast + dinner for two and a petting zoo next door.
